reply.text:
I like having a date on it. "Shredded" is mostly two things: keeping your muscle while your body fat comes down, and eating consistently enough for that to happen, and June gives you about seven months to do it properly.

Want me to build the training block first? Tell me how many days a week you can train, how long your sessions run, and where you train, and the app will build it around those. I can also set your calorie and macro targets for a cut once you tell me the pace you want, though I can't promise a specific result by a specific date.
